name: Text to image (SD-Turbo, 1 step)
note: The smallest model: draws in one step.

name: Text to image (Stable Diffusion 1.5, real guidance)
note: 20 steps with a negative prompt; downloads 4.4 GB the first time.

name: Image to image
note: Upload a picture, pick it in Load Image, then Queue.

name: Hires fix (draw small, upscale the latent, refine)
Inpainting (paint the mask yourself)
note: Upload a picture, right-click Load Image > Open in Mask Editor, paint, Queue.

name: FLUX.2 Klein text to image
note: 4B model, 4 steps; downloads 4.6 GB the first time. Needs a GPU with about 4 GB free.

name: FLUX 3 Klein text to image
note: 5.6B model, 16 steps, wants a full scene caption; downloads 6 GB the first time.

name: FLUX.2 Klein picture edit
note: Edits the picture you load, following the prompt.

name: LLM writes the prompt, SD-Turbo draws it
note: A small local language model expands your idea into a prompt.

name: Upscale a picture with a model
note: ESPCN x3, a few hundred KB.

name: Remove the background
note: RMBG 1.4: the mask, and the cut-out on green.

name: Pose and object detection
note: Boxes around what is in the picture, the list of what was found, and the body skeleton.

name: Speak and listen (Kokoro, then Parakeet)
note: Text to speech, then the speech back to text (the listener needs a desktop GPU).

name: Image to 3D model (TRELLIS.2)
note: Upload a picture of one object, pick it in Load Image, Queue; right-click Save 3D Model > View 3D model. About 10 GB the first time.
